$comment: Ground-truth cases excluded from scoring because the CAPTURE is unreliable, not because the engine is wrong. Two classes: (1) 'chrome' — the cursor read browser UI (tab strip, toolbar, menus) instead of the page; (2) 'cursor-walk' — the cursor walk dropped, duplicated, or mis-read page content (e.g. skipped a heading, recorded the wrong aria-level), so the recorded phrases do not reflect what VoiceOver actually announces for the element. Each entry is scored as INCOMPLETE (quarantined), never silently dropped, so the report stays honest. Integrity rule: we quarantine bad captures; we NEVER degrade a correct engine to match them. Re-capture with the force-into-web-content fix, re-run triage, and remove from this list once the capture is clean.
